name: GFX_hof_ic_malenkow_the_party_card_index
title: 党员登记卡
concept: One partially pulled-out WOODEN card-index drawer dominates the center. Inside stand many cream, physically thick handwritten registration cards in close parallel rows; writing must be just unreadable tiny gray strokes. The foremost card has ONE upturned paper corner. Show the box's rails, dividers and tactile thickness of cards. No stamp, ink seal or stamping action. Restrained natural warm wood and aged paper; no red in the central scene.

name: GFX_hof_ic_malenkow_the_cadres_directorate
title: 中央干部管理局
concept: A tabletop still-life: ONE open thick registry ledger with abstract illegible rows, next to ONE compact desk stamp. A row of wooden card-index cabinets recedes softly behind. Only a small RED ink pad trace on the stamp base provides the central scene's sole red accent; no other central red. Strong legibility at tiny size: ledger and stamp should dominate, cabinets subordinate. No writing readable, no hands or people.

name: GFX_hof_ic_malenkow_the_state_defence_committee
title: 国防委员会
concept: A dark wooden long meeting table with EXACTLY FIVE empty chairs arranged around it, easy to count: one at head, two per long side; no sixth chair. On the table a single black 1940s rotary telephone. Behind, a muted cream wall map with abstract geographic patches and absolutely no place names or directional arrows. Empty wartime council room, but no weapons or people. Natural dark wood, aged map cream and black telephone only; no red in central scene.

name: GFX_hof_ic_malenkow_the_aviation_affair
title: 航空案
concept: Inside a gray-blue 1940s aircraft hangar, a SINGLE grounded aircraft visible only as a neutral gray SILHOUETTE in the distant background; absolutely no military roundel, insignia or combat scene. In the foreground a modest desk with a short STACK OF OPENED INSPECTION RECORD PAGES, abstract unreadable marks and dog-eared paper corners. The papers are the focus, aircraft is context. Gray-blue belongs only to hangar structure, neutral gray aircraft, paper cream. No red in central scene.

name: GFX_hof_ic_malenkow_the_party_schools
title: 党校
concept: A quiet empty training classroom: one ordered ROW of wooden school desks receding toward a DEEP MUTED GREEN chalkboard. Chalkboard shows only a few abstract outline strokes and horizontal bars suggesting an outline; NO recognizable letters, Cyrillic, Chinese, numerals or icons. Wood, cream chalk and deep dark green chalkboard only. No people, portraits, flags or central red.

name: GFX_hof_ic_malenkow_the_premiership
title: 部长会议主席
concept: A single CLOSED HARD-COVER REGISTER BOOK standing UPRIGHT on a dark wooden desk, its plain cover facing us and COMPLETELY BLANK, no letters, insignia, title, image or emblem. Beside it just a small fan of worn physical index cards, bent edges from long handling. The upright book dominates and feels like the final authority derived from years of card keeping. Natural brown cover, cream worn cards, wood desk; no central red.
